gowgandaBody: Tonnage and grade information for the Gowganda silver tailings (Miller Lake-O'Brien) referred to on this website is derived from [full title of the 2011 technical report], prepared by [author] for [prior owner] in [2011], before the Company acquired its interest in the property, and is a historical estimate within the meaning of NI 43-101. [Categories and key parameters, to the extent known.] The Company has not verified the historical estimate. A qualified person has not done sufficient work to classify the historical estimate as current mineral resources or mineral reserves, and the Company is not treating the historical estimate as current mineral resources or mineral reserves. The Company has engaged [GeoVector Management Inc.] to prepare a current mineral resource estimate for the tailings, which will require [verification sampling, density determinations and QA/QC review]. No economic analysis of the tailings has been completed under a current technical report.
castleEastBody: The 2021 mineral resource estimate for the Castle East Robinson Zone referred to on this website was prepared by GoldMinds Geoservices Inc. (Merouane Rachidi, P.Geo., Ph.D.) for the Company, then named Canada Silver Cobalt Works Inc., in the NI 43-101 Technical Report Update for Castle East, Ontario, Canada, effective April 30, 2021, and is based on the Company's own drilling. The Company's current technical report on the Castle Silver Property (Ronacher McKenzie Geoscience Inc., effective December 3, 2025) does not include an updated mineral resource estimate and treats the 2021 estimate as historical. A qualified person has not done sufficient work to classify the 2021 estimate as current mineral resources, the Company is not treating it as current mineral resources, and it should not be relied upon. [Work required to update or verify the estimate, per the December 2025 technical report.]
productionBody: References to historical production from past-producing mines in the Cobalt-Gowganda camp, including Castle, Capitol and Miller Lake-O'Brien, are derived from public records and have not been verified by the Company. They are provided as context on the district's mining history only and are not indicative of mineralization on the Company's claims or of economic viability. There is no assurance that the Company's exploration programs will confirm economically mineable mineralization, or that any future mineral resource estimate will reflect similar grades or tonnages.
